captions.caption: A wide shot of a chicken coop area with many chickens and turkeys inside a netted fence.
Panning across the enclosure, showing a small portable wooden chicken coop on wheels.
More birds are visible inside the fenced area next to the coop.
The camera continues panning right, showing the edge of the enclosure and the surrounding field.
A long stretch of white plastic netting is lying flat on the grass outside the main enclosure.
A man is seen in the distance, pulling the netting across the field.
The man continues to unroll and pull the white netting across the green grass.
Close-up on the man as he walks along a section of fence that is already standing.
The man walks beside the fence, with the coop and more birds visible in the background.
Panning shot of the standing fence and the field beyond.
The man stops by a fence post and prepares to adjust it.
The man grips a white fence post and begins to position it.
The man uses his foot to pull the bottom of the netting tight near the post.
He steps down on the base of the post to drive the spikes into the ground.
The man finishes stepping in the post and moves to the next section.
He walks forward, carrying the next section of netting.
The man reaches the next post location and starts pulling the netting taut.
He aligns the post and gets ready to step it into the soil.
A close-up shot focuses on his boots as he prepares to step on the post base.
His boot is positioned over the double spike at the bottom of the white post.
He uses his foot to pull the bottom strand of the net tight.
He places his weight on the post's base plate with his foot.
The man continues to push the post into the ground with his boot.
He makes sure the post is secure and the net is tight at the bottom.
The camera stays on the boots as he adjusts the tension.
He successfully drives the spikes fully into the earth.
He removes his foot from the post base.
He checks the post one last time before moving on.
He encounters a slight struggle, perhaps hitting a rock while pushing.
He adjusts the angle and pushes down again firmly.
The post is now firmly in place in the ground.
He steps away from the newly secured fence post.
The man walks towards the next section of the netting.
He picks up the next post and pulls the netting along.
He walks across the field with the netting trailing behind him.
The camera pans out to show the length of the fence he is installing.
The fence stretches across the grassy field towards the woods.
A view of the existing chicken enclosure with the portable coop.
The camera pans across the field, showing the new fence line and the farm area.
More birds are seen moving around inside the original fence.
The man is seen in the distance, continuing to work on the fence line.
He reaches another point and prepares to plant the next post.
He pulls the netting tight before stepping the post in.
He pushes the post into the ground using his boot.
He moves to the next post, pulling the white netting along.
He stops and positions the next post in the row.
He uses his foot to tension the bottom of the net and step the post down.
The man walks quickly to the next section of the portable fencing.
He pulls the netting and post into position.
He steps the post into the ground with a firm motion.
He continues walking along the perimeter of the new enclosure.
He prepares the next post for installation.
He drives the post into the earth with his boot.
He moves forward again, dragging the remaining netting.
A wide shot shows the man working and the coop in the background.
The chickens and turkeys are visible in their current pen.
The man continues to set up the new fence area for rotation.
The camera focuses on the birds in the original enclosure.
The screen transitions to a white background with floating paper scraps.
Social media icons and links appear on the screen as the video ends.
